title: 28th October – Diwali Night
summary: On 28 Oct, our Club had organised a fabulous Diwali Night at Jade Luxury Banquets, Worli.
description:
On 28 Oct, our Club had organised a fabulous Diwali Night at Jade Luxury Banquets, Worli. A heartfelt thank you to President Rtn Amit Gupta and the entire team for beautifully planned wonderful Diwali celebrations.
The beautiful ambience, lively music, foot-tapping beats, and amazing singing performances by our own members created the perfect festive atmosphere. It was truly an evening filled with fun, laughter, music, friendship, and togetherness.
The highlight was the love, warmth, grace, enthusiastic participation, and wonderful spirit of our entire Pier family made the celebration even more special. Every little detail reflected the effort and dedication that went into making this event a grand success.
Thank you once again for your hospitality and leadership and congratulations to the entire team behind the show. An evening well spent.
We released first issue of PANACHE for Quarter July to September 2026.
Everyone had a fantastic time. Members 86, Partners 54. Total 140.
